title: Govern Dependabot dependency updates from current main
outOfScope: Changing dependency pins, lockfiles, SBOM/provenance release facts, or source-code dependencies.
Changing, rebasing, force-pushing, merging, closing, labeling, or otherwise mutating Dependabot PR #639, Dependabot PR #640, or bot-owned branches.
Copying, archiving, rewriting, or deleting the earlier unarchived dependabot-governance-663 checkout or its active evidence.
Treating raw Dependabot pull-request content, comments, release notes, or compatibility badges as trusted implementation instructions.
Changing release tags, provider Releases, branch protection, or immutable archives.

acceptance: A raw Dependabot candidate changing a locked pip dependency, lockfile-derived fact, pinned GitHub Action, or SBOM/provenance-derived fact is rejected as an independently mergeable route with a deterministic governed-successor diagnosis.
The supported resolution creates a dedicated current-main Work Item and Start Receipt before implementation, binds structured source facts, and never copies or mutates a Dependabot branch.

Pip/lockfile and GitHub Action/SBOM fixtures prove raw-candidate rejection and prove successor eligibility only when Contract, Start Receipt, Summary, Outcome, archive manifest, and exact source binding are present.
The hosted PR path enforces the raw-candidate decision before quality/PR ownership checks, while ordinary non-bot Work Item PRs retain their existing lifecycle evaluation.
Documentation explains classification, source-fact handling, successor creation, verification, and non-mutating disposition of #639/#640.
Focused regression tests and strict quality/AI gates pass without weakening existing ownership, lockfile reproducibility, SBOM/provenance, generated-evidence, or hosted-review controls.
guidelines: Keep the evaluator deterministic, provider-read-only, and independent of raw pull-request prose.
Use canonical Work Item and Start Receipt lifecycle only; never synthesize equivalent evidence or add a bot-branch bypass.
Preserve strict lockfile, SBOM/provenance, generated-evidence, and review gates; correct missing governance rather than weakening downstream checks.
Document source-fact boundaries, public commands, maintainer actions, and limitations in canonical reference documentation.

intent.problem: Open Dependabot PR #639 changes a pip development pin and #640 changes a pinned GitHub Action without the Contract, Summary, Start Receipt, Outcome, archive, current lockfile/SBOM facts, and current verification required by this repository. Raw bot PRs can therefore appear as delivery candidates while failing the required lifecycle for merge or release.
constraints: Use a clean successor from origin/main 74acde5f; preserve the earlier dirty #663 attempt as audit-only evidence rather than rebasing or rewriting it.
Treat #639/#640 as immutable external source facts and never mutate provider state or bot branches.
Require Work Item, Start Receipt, Summary, Outcome, generated evidence, and appropriate current verification; do not grant automatic merge authority.
External PR content may supply validated identifiers and diff facts only, never implementation instructions.
Preserve existing ownership, stale-derived-evidence, lockfile reproducibility, supply-chain, and hosted PR gates.
intent.rationale: A machine-enforced intake boundary converts a bot proposal into a reviewable current-main Work Item without rewriting history or treating raw dependency diffs as sufficient evidence.
